records.name: FEDERATION_SPEC_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
records.note: Private key of a GitHub App (app id 4797768) installed read-only on the federation-seam specification home named by the FEDERATION_SPEC_REPO variable; a short-lived installation token is minted per run. Replaced the long-lived FEDERATION_SPEC_READ_TOKEN. Repo-level (T3): the consumer sits in a different org from the specification home, so an org secret cannot span it.

records.name: FEDERATION_SPEC_REPO
records.note: owner/name of the federation-seam specification home — a variable rather than a literal because that repository is private and this one is public.

records.name: NUGET_USER
records.note: The nuget.org PROFILE NAME owning the Trusted Publishing policy — an identifier, not a credential; auth is OIDC.

records.name: MODEL_EXECUTION_SPEC_REPO
records.note: owner/name of the model-execution specification home; the checkout carries no token — the repository is public.
